information: In 2026, we kick off the year with the first competition in the city of Tarija. The competition will take place at the [Bolivian American Center Tarija](https://www.facebook.com/centrobolivianoamericano.tarija), and we sincerely appreciate them for opening their doors to us. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBAOpenTarija2026#72367-informacion-de-pago) This competition is open to all public. **More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBAOpenTarija2026#67893-faq-pmf)** Este 2026 iniciamos con la primera competición del año en la ciudad de Tarija. La competición se realizará en el [Centro Boliviano Americano Tarija](https://www.facebook.com/centrobolivianoamericano.tarija), a quienes agradecemos por abrirnos sus puertas. Para ver la información acerca del pago de inscripción, entra al siguiente link.
